how: Opened the public Gemini share page and selected the longest response (a <message-content> element: a ~40k-character answer with nested lists and tables) with a DOM range, then ran document.execCommand("copy"). The shared (signed-out) view has no per-response copy button, only "Copy prompt" on user turns, so there is no copy-button capture.
notes: Gemini share page selection: 12 <ul>, 32 <li>, 12 headings, no tables or code. No copy button on the share page.
